paragraphs: R' Elazar ben Shemua, [Mishnah Peah 5:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Peah.5.2); Yehudah ben Shemua, [Rosh Hashanah 19a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.19a.5-7).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Nehemiah names Shemua, and the Mishnah names Rabbi Elazar ben Shemua.

The linked Rosh Hashanah names Yehudah ben Shemua in a separate account. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3402&lang=en) names both as sons under the headword Shemua the Priest.
